historyCoverage: Complete modern Olympic swimming archive (1988–2024) across premier blue-riband events.

sections.title: Men's 100m Freestyle
sections.sourceLabel: World Aquatics Official Men's 100m Free Archive

records.margin: Paris La Défense Arena; shattered his own World Record by 0.40s; won by massive 1.08s margin over Chalmers (47.48)
Tokyo Aquatics Centre; edged Chalmers by 0.06s in electric finish
Olympic Aquatics Stadium, Rio; 18-year-old Australian stormed from 7th at the turn to win gold
London Aquatics Centre; dramatic 0.01-second margin of victory over 'The Missile' Magnussen (47.53)
Water Cube, Beijing; Bernard edged World Record holder Sullivan (47.32); Jason Lezak & César Cielo tied bronze
Athens Olympic Aquatic Centre; defended title; held off Schoeman (48.23) and Ian Thorpe (48.56)
Sydney International Aquatic Centre; broke Popov's 8-year Olympic reign; set WR 47.84 in semi-final
Georgia Tech Aquatic Center, Atlanta; defended 100m gold against home favorite Hall (49.04)
Piscines Bernat Picornell, Barcelona; 20-year-old Russian sprinted past defending champion Biondi
Jamsil Indoor Swimming Pool, Seoul; Biondi's first individual gold of historic 5-gold, 7-medal Games

sections.title: Women's 100m Freestyle
sections.sourceLabel: World Aquatics Official Women's 100m Free Archive

records.margin: Paris La Défense Arena; 30-year-old sprint legend captured gold from lane 7; Huske 52.29, Siobhán Haughey 52.33
Tokyo Aquatics Centre; first woman under 52 seconds in Olympic history; part of record 7-medal haul in Tokyo
Rio; historic dead heat; Manuel became first Black woman to win individual Olympic swimming gold; Oleksiak won at age 16
London Aquatics Centre; completed 50m/100m sprint double
Water Cube, Beijing; edged World Record holder Trickett by 0.04s (53.16)
Athens; Henry set World Record (53.52) in semi-finals before defeating defending champion De Bruijn
Sydney; 'Invincible Inge' won 50m, 100m Free and 100m Fly gold medals
Atlanta; World Champion led from the gun
Barcelona; China's first-ever Olympic swimming gold medal, edging world record holder Thompson
Seoul; first woman to win 6 gold medals at a single Olympic Games

sections.title: Women's 800m Freestyle
sections.sourceLabel: World Aquatics Official Women's 800m Free Archive

records.margin: Paris; historic 4-peat (joined Michael Phelps as only swimmers to win same individual Olympic event 4 times)
Tokyo; 3-peat; held off Titmus (8:13.83) by 1.26s
Rio; shattered World Record by nearly 2 seconds; won by an astonishing 11.38-second margin
London; 15-year-old sensation stunned home favorite Rebecca Adlington
Beijing; shattered Janet Evans's legendary 19-year-old World Record
Athens; surprise victory from lane 6 over French star Manaudou
Sydney; broke Janet Evans's 1988 Olympic record
